headline: Earnings rise both year over year and sequentially
summary_short: Blau Farmacêutica reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of R$0.31, up 10.5% y/y from R$0.28.
summary_long: EPS of R$0.31 rose 10.5% year-over-year from R$0.28 and 79.9% sequentially from R$0.17 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
